html: The Kaniyang, also spelt Kaneang, are a Noongar people of the inland south west of Western Australia. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815, in the country of the upper Blackwood River. Little is written about them as a separate group. Their neighbours were other Noongar peoples: the Wiilman to the north, the Bibbulman and Wardandi to the west, the Pinjarup to the northwest and the Minang to the south. Farms and timber cutting spread over their land through the later 1800s.
